name: Mateo
summary: Operations manager, partner and two children, intermediate investment experience. Places high importance on ESG and wants to avoid companies involved in significant environmental or social controversies.
objective: Balanced capital growth over the medium and long term.
risk_tolerance_note: Official profile: moderate risk. Open to emerging technologies when they fit his profile; little interest in highly speculative investments.

goals.label: Balanced growth (family, medium-long term)
goals.horizon_note: stated horizon 8-12 years; lower bound used (conservative assumption)

_origin.excluded_sectors: derived from ESG preference: fossil-fuel exclusion as a proxy (assumption)
_origin.pref_max_security_risk_units: derived from 'little interest in highly speculative investments' (assumption)
_origin.pref_pass_esg_screen: derived from 'avoid companies involved in significant controversies'; evidence = ESGV holdings in SEC N-PORT (assumption: proxy)

likes: emerging tech if it fits his risk profile
dislikes: companies with significant environmental or social controversies

sample_requests: Exxon pays a great dividend. Put $10,000 of new money into XOM.
Add $10,000 of new money to XESG.TO, it's an ESG fund.
Switch $20,000 from ESGV to SPY to save on fees.
Add $8,000 of new money to Johnson & Johnson, it's a defensive stock.
